lines.en: label day297:
scene toukafirstday1
: So yeah! That’s basically how I wound up becoming the adoptive mother of an energy draining chicken named Todd!
: Woah! I had no idea the story behind that little guy was so heart wrenching and inspiring, Ayane!
: When exactly did my podium become a place for bird related gossip?
scene toukafirstday2
: This here’s a free country, Sensei. Every podium is a bird gossip podium if you try hard and believe in yourself!
: Also, Nodoka stole my desk and has just been sitting there staring off into space for the last hour or so, so I have nothing else to do.
: But it actually works out perfectly since I wanted to be around you anyway!
: You always want to be around me. Don’t make it sound like some sort of special occurrence.
: Yes, yes! Flirt harder! Just what I need to get my blood pumpin’ first thing in the morning!
: This doesn’t really constitute flirting, Uta.
: I figured if anyone would know that, it would be you.
scene toukafirstday3
: Hey, now! Don’t go giving my good friend here any ideas about our totally platonic relationship, Sensei.
: I understand that you may be in love with me, but I am far too [young]to get involved with a man like you unless the price is right.
: What is the price? Just name it and I’ll make it happen.
: Six million US dollars.
: Ayane, can I borrow six million US dollars?
scene toukafirstday4
: How much money do you think my family made off of unpoppable bubble wrap, Sensei?
: We may be rich, but even we can’t hand out that much just because it will help you purchase Uta.
: So it’s not the fact that I want to purchase her, it’s the fact that she’s too expensive.
: I’m a high quality product made with only the finest ingredients.
scene toukafirstday5
: Also, you can have me for free. And I’ll do everything that Uta can plus more.
: That’s right, Sensei. And she doesn’t even need to talk to her parents first.
: This baby right here can fit so much Sensei inside of her that you could probably even clone yourself and she still wouldn’t be satisfied.
scene toukafirstday6
: Oh, Uta. You say the strangest things sometimes. As if I’d ever need more than one Sensei.
: That’s what she says...but just look at those eyes! She’s clearly in heat!
: In fact, she's so hot that just one Sensei wouldn’t even come close to-
: Please don’t continue saying things like this in a classroom full of girls who would likely kill both you and me for carrying on any longer.
scene toukafirstday7
: Back to the matter at hand, then!
: What matter at hand? You two spent ten minutes talking about a chicken. What more could there possibly be to say?
: No, no! Not chicken stuff!
: Ayane and me didn’t just stumble on over here because Nodoka went into hibernation mode. We came over because we had an idea to run by you!
: An idea? What kind of idea?
scene toukafirstday8
: So, you know how the beach trip thing is right around the corner even though it’s the middle of winter?
: Yes. This has been a recurring subject lately.
: Do you two need me to watch you try on swimsuits as well?
: Because that isn't really something I am interested in, but I will do it if you require financial advice and budgeting tips.
scene toukafirstday9
: As well? Who did ya watch the first time?
: Wait, don’t tell me! It’s gotta be-
: No one.
: Am I right, though?
: Not really. I mean, I’d be more than happy to try on anything you want me to try on in front of you, but that’s not why we’re here.
: I don’t know my parents' rules for gettin’ changed in front of boys, but I’m pretty sure I’m not allowed to do that.
: Then what? What would be so important that you would interrupt my incredibly busy schedule to-
scene toukafirstday10
: An orgy.
: Done. Let’s go.
: An orgy of fun.
: I don’t know what that means, but as long as it’s still an orgy, I’m game.
scene toukafirstday11
: Okay, now that we have your attention, we should clarify that it isn’t really an orgy at all.
: You already had my attention. Making false promises is just going to ruin my day.
: Why would you do this to me?
: Because yeah!
: What does that even mean?...
scene toukafirstday12
: All you really need to know is that Ayane and me are plannin’ a thing that we’re gonna need your help for soon!
: Why not right now? I have some time to kill.
: It wouldn’t be balanced enough! We need to even the playing field!
: Thankfully, my cute girl senses are tingling and we’re about to get one step closer!
: Why do you have cute girl senses and what can I do to also get them?
: Just close your eyes and believe, Sensei...
scene black
I close my eyes and attempt to believe.
The only issue is that I have no idea what I’m believing in and-
: Excuse us...
You have maybe(?) acquired Uta-chan’s second secret ability, cute girl sense!
scene toukafirstday13
: Hello again. And thanks for allowing my daughter to join your classroom.
: Yes...Thank you very much for accepting me on such short notice.
: I do understand that my appearance may come at a rather inconvenient time, but I’m excited to get to know every-
scene toukafirstday14
: Wait...You wouldn’t happen to be the commoner I ran into at the dojo months prior, would you?
: Touka, darling. This man is your teacher now. You can not be calling him a commoner.
scene toukafirstday15
: Ah! I sincerely apologize if I offended you.
: It’s just that the people I typically associate with are a lot...different from the ones here.
: Well, putting your ingrained judgementalness aside for a moment, I’d like to say hello and welcome to my totally normal classroom.
: I hope you enjoy never learning anything ever again for the rest of your [high_school] life.
scene toukafirstday16
: I beg your pardon?
: Hahahah! See? Isn’t he hilarious?
: It’s the perfect environment for you, dear.
scene toukafirstday17
: But, just to be sure, how about I stay here and observe you for the rest of the period? Just to make sure everything is up to our...expectations, of course.
: That won’t be necess-
: That sounds splendid. Thank you kindly, mother.
: Okay. I guess Tsubasa will be here today too.
I can already tell that this is not going to go well.
scene toukafirstday18
: Holy crap. What’s the princess of Kumon-mi doing in our classroom?
: Princess of Kumon-mi?
scene toukafirstday19
: She’s like...totally loaded.
: Like, loaded enough to have a classroom in our last[school] with her very own teachers and her very own lunch period and just...
: I don’t know. She’s got a lot of money.
: I like her hat.
: It’s...a good hat?
: I want to wear her hat.
scene toukafirstday20
: Uhh...cool.
: What is...um...a princess...doing in our class?
: That’s what I want to know.
: I could have sworn that I wouldn’t be seeing her again until our last[school] was...unearthed or rebuilt or whatever it is that family is doing to put it back together.
: Her family is funding the new Kumon-mi Academy?
: That’s what I heard at least. But they own like 10%% of the entire district, so it would make sense.
: What does her family even do?
: Beats me. Rich people stuff? Yakuza, maybe?
: She doesn’t look like the yakuza type...
: Yeah. We already have a girl with connections like that and she’s basically the opposite of rich anyway.
: Well...whatever the case...I doubt she’ll last.
: I give it like a week before she’s gone again. Calling it now.
scene toukafirstday21
: I’d like to thank you for allowing my mother to stay here and supervise.
: I can assure you it will be just for today.
: It’s my very first time in a classroom with other girls my age, so I’m a little nervous.
: Just don’t call anyone a commoner or a peasant and I’m sure you’ll be fine.
: Understood!
: Now, where is my desk? I’d like to begin today’s lessons with English, if you wouldn’t mind.
: Yeah, that’s not how things really work here.
scene toukafirstday22
: It’s not?
: It’s not.
: Kendo Princess, the time has come to choose a name for our newest recruit!
: I am thinking something seductive...like...maybe some sort of succubus name?
: Are you familiar with succubi?
: Suck ...what?
: Please do not try to get me to do anything strange in the middle of class, Emerald Guardian.
: Do your students always spend their free time discussing...whatever those two are discussing?
: They do. And you’ll be doing the same starting now.
: But...how will this impact my education?
: If I don’t receive enough attention, I’ll fall behind in my studies and-
: You’ll be fine. Don’t worry about it.
scene toukafirstday23
: What do you mean, “Don’t worry about it?” You are a teacher. It is literally your job to teach.
: If you aren’t willing to do even that much, I’ll talk to my mother and have myself transferred right now.
: Sure. See ya.
: It was nice seeing you again.
scene toukafirstday24
: You-
: Show some respect! Do you have any idea who I am?
: Some rich girl looking for special treatment.
scene toukafirstday25
: How...dare you...
: Mother!
: Oh, Tsubasa! You’re already here.
scene toukafirstday26
: Good afternoon, dear! Don’t mind me. I’m just here to observe my daughter’s first day in her new[school].
: Mo...Mother? Hello?
: I am being abused. I require assistance.
: Being treated like everyone else isn’t abuse, Tooru.
scene toukafirstday27
: My name is Touka!
: Tomoko?
scene toukafirstday28
: TOUKA!
: TOUKA TSUKIOKA OF THE TSUKIOKA FAMILY! THE WEALTHIEST FAMILY IN KUMON-MI!
: YOU WILL REFER TO ME BY MY PROPER NAME OR-
: Why don’t you go take a seat, Toshiko?
: MOTHER! CALL FATHER IMMEDIATELY! I WANT THIS MAN ARRESTED!
: No can do, dear! I’ve already entrusted your future to him.
scene toukafirstday29
: I am to wed this heathen?!
: Not if I have a say in it...
scene toukafirstday30
: Wait...you’re the other person from the dojo!
: Ayane Amamiya! I remember that name.
: Nice to see you again, Touka. Are you transferring into our class?
scene toukafirstday31
: That was the plan. But it appears that our teacher has decided to do anything but the job he is being paid for.
: Not to mention I’m not seeing my special desk anywhere in sight.
: Special desk?
: Of course. I’ve been using the same desk since elementary[school] and I refuse to study without-
: Oh, Touka darling...That desk wouldn’t fit in the classroom. So you’ll be using a standard one starting today.
scene toukafirstday32
: St...Standard?
: You...do actually remember her name, right?
: Of course. But I’m not going to let some girl start dictating the way I run my class just because she comes from money.
: I’d do the same thing if you started making me give you special lessons.
scene toukafirstday33
: Oh, you’ve given me plenty of “special lessons,” Sensei.
: How is it at all fair that she receives special lessons and I do not?
: She is...not talking about the same type of lessons you are, Tama.
scene toukafirstday34
: I will not allow my mind to be tampered with by a man like you.
: Good. That’s probably the smartest thing you could do right now.
scene toukafirstday35
: The first step to truly experiencing the outside world is to not imagine that everything revolves around you.
: You won’t get special treatment while you’re here, because you’re no more special than anyone else.
: If you can’t accept that, you should probably just go back home to your butlers and your maids or whatever and study at your “special desk.”
: But, if you want to see what “commoners” live like, feel free to stick around.
scene toukafirstday36
: Mother! Call father immediately!
Damn. I thought for a second that might actually work.
scene toukafirstday37
: What’s wrong, my love?
: This[school] is bad. I want to return to the manor.
: The day just started, dear. You can’t go home yet.
: What do you mean I can’t go home? How am I supposed to learn without my desk and without a teacher?
: We have a teacher. He’s just a little weird.
: Hey.
: “A little weird” seems to be quite the understatement.
: You’ll get used to it.
: I’m Chika, by the way. I’m kind of friends with your mom, I guess. So I hope you and I can get along as well.
scene toukafirstday38
: Get along? With me?
: Yeah! You’re new here, and that can be pretty overwhelming at first.
: Especially when I’m sure everything is like, totally different from your last[school].
: But, weirdly enough, you’re in pretty good hands. This place really isn’t all that bad.
: So if you ever need somebody to talk to or anything like that, just come look for me in the back of the classroom.
scene toukafirstday39
: Oh! Um...
: Thank you very much, Chika. I’m very excited to get to know you.
: And then everyone lived happily ever-
scene toukafirstday40
: Silence. I may not understand how to act in places like this, but even I can understand when I am being ridiculed.
: At the very least, please address me by my actual name. It may be a silly thing to press you on, but it is very important to me.
: Fine.
: Welcome to the class, Touka.
scene toukafirstday41
: Thank you very much...
: Oh my. This is the cutest expression I’ve seen on your face in years.
: I knew this[school] was the right choice for you.
scene toukafirstday42
: Wha-
: The climate control in this room is just...virtually non-existent!
: If my face is as red as it feels, that is the reason why! This is no cute expression!
: And...And it has nothing to do with embarrassment! I swear!
: Right, dear. Of course it doesn’t.
scene toukafirstday43
: Well, it's premature, but I suppose I’ve seen all I’ve needed to see here.
What? It's been like two minutes.
: I understand that there will be no special treatment for her, but please at least see to it that my daughter makes it to her limo after the[school] day ends.
: You’re sending a limo for her?
: She has fencing lessons shortly after the final bell in a remote location that only our driver is familiar with.
: That much shouldn’t be a problem, should it?
: I...guess not?
: Splendid.
: And thank you again for taking her in at such an inconvenient time of the year. We really do appreciate it.
: Touka, please thank your teacher.
: Louder, dear.
scene toukafirstday44
: TH-TH-THANKYOUFORLOOKINGAFTERME!
: I WILL NOW GO SIT AT MY STANDARD, NOT SPECIAL DESK AND NOT LEARN ABOUT ENGLISH!
: GOODBYE!
scene black
Touka doesn’t choose a desk right away, but instead bashfully walks over to Ayane and tugs on her sleeve.
It seems that Ayane understands exactly what Touka needs (Probably due to rich girl senses or something) and then proceeds to find her a free desk.
The two of them sit down together and begin to talk as I see Tsubasa out.

Chika winds up leaving at the same time after receiving a call from her sister, so she isn’t able to help Touka get any more accustomed to life here than she’s already become over the last twenty minutes or so.
Either way, the rest of the day proceeds pretty normally and then, just as all things do, it comes to an end.
I’m not sure if Touka likes it here yet, but I guess I’ve been lucky enough so far to have almost every new student be welcomed with open arms immediately.
At the very least, even if she doesn’t wind up liking me (Which I’m sure she will because I’m me), she’ll have Ayane and Chika.
And anyone else willing to look past her outward appearance and social status.
Which, judging by the mood of the room-
Does not seem like many people.

$ day297 = True
Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
